highlights: Runs GET and POST smoke checks
Supports environment variable interpolation in headers and bodies
name: API Smoke Probe
description: Run lightweight checks against HTTP APIs, assert status codes and JSON fields, and notify on failures.

files.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --quiet -r requirements.txt
python main.py
